title: Design System: BHMac — Battery Health Menu Bar

display.purpose: The status item's live temperature, in tabular digits.

measurement.purpose: Every number in the register, plus the scale ticks.

section-head.purpose: The three register sections, uppercase and tracked.

scale-tick.purpose: The 35° and 42° threshold labels under the ruler.

motion.name: needle-settle
motion.purpose: The thermal scale's needle slides in from the left edge once per menu open. Disabled when the system's Reduce Motion is on.

components.name: Status Item
components.description: The live battery temperature in the menu bar: tier-tinted thermometer glyph plus the reading in tabular digits.
components.css: .ds-status-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3pt; height: 22pt; font: 13pt/22pt -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #34C759; background: transparent; border: none; } .ds-status-item__glyph { width: 10pt; height: 13pt; background: currentColor; border-radius: 2pt; flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-status-item__reading { background: transparent; border: none; }

components.name: Metric Row
components.description: One measurement register: named label on the left column, reading right-aligned to the shared edge.
components.css: .ds-metric-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 104pt 1fr; align-items: center; width: 288pt; height: 24pt; padding: 0 12pt; background: transparent; border: none; } .ds-metric-row__label { font: 11pt -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; color: #7F7F7F; } .ds-metric-row__value { font: 600 11pt 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; color: #000000; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Metric Row — State Word
components.description: A reading carrying a state word, set in the human face and colored when the state is an alarm.
components.css: .ds-metric-row__num { font: 600 11pt 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; color: #000000; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-metric-row__note { font: 11pt -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; color: #34C759; margin-left: 0.35em; }

components.name: Section Head
components.description: Uppercase, tracked head that opens a register group, with more air above than below.
components.css: .ds-section-head { width: 288pt; height: 26pt; padding: 0 12pt 0; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; padding-bottom: 5pt; font: 500 10pt -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #7F7F7F; background: transparent; }

components.name: Thermal Scale
components.description: The signature graphic: hairline ruler over a 20–50 °C domain, the live tier's band lit, threshold ticks labelled, needle at the reading.
components.html: 35°42°
components.css: .ds-scale { width: 288pt; height: 30pt; background: transparent; } .ds-scale__track { position: relative; height: 2.5pt; margin: 8.75pt 12pt 0; background: #E8E8EA; border-radius: 1.25pt; } .ds-scale__band { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 50%; background: #34C759; border-radius: 1.25pt; } .ds-scale__tick { position: absolute; top: -1.75pt; width: 1.5pt; height: 6pt; background: #7F7F7F; } .ds-scale__tick[data-t='35'] { left: 50%; } .ds-scale__tick[data-t='42'] { left: 73.3%; } .ds-scale__needle { position: absolute; top: -4.25pt; left: 48.7%; width: 2.5pt; height: 11pt; background: #000000; border-radius: 1.25pt; transition: left 0.24s cubic-bezier(0.3, 0.15, 0.15, 1); } .ds-scale__labels { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin: 4pt 12pt 0; font: 8.5pt 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; color: #7F7F7F; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-scale__needle { transition: none; } }

components.name: Separator
components.description: The menu's own hairline rule between register sections, set the width of the content.
components.css: .ds-separator { width: 288pt; height: 13pt; display: flex; align-items: center; background: transparent; } .ds-separator::after { content: ''; display: block; width: 100%; margin: 0 12pt; height: 0.5pt; background: #E8E8EA; }

components.name: Message Row
components.description: The no-battery case: one plain line, no register, no icon.
components.css: .ds-message-row { width: 288pt; height: 22pt; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 12pt; font: 11pt -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; color: #7F7F7F; background: transparent; }

narrative.overview: BHMac is a measurement instrument that happens to live in a menu bar. One voice for numbers, one voice for words, one accent for state, and nothing that is not a measurement. It refuses the menu-bar-utility genre default — icon packs and unaligned 'Label — value' lists — as hard as it refuses the neon telemetry dashboard opposite. A battery instrument should read correctly at a glance across a desk.
keyCharacteristics: Two type voices, never mixed: SF Pro speaks words, SF Mono speaks numbers.
One accent, spent in exactly four places: status item, live temperature, thermal scale, health band word.
The material is the menu's own: no background, no border, no card, no shadow is drawn.
Fixed geometry: 288pt register, one 104pt label column, readings sharing one right edge.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The tier palette is the only color in the product, and it is used in exactly four places. A fifth use is a defect.

rules.name: The Never-Color-Only Rule
rules.body: Color is never the sole carrier of a state. Every tier is also written as a word; the scale's thresholds are labelled. The color is the alarm; the text is the message.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: SF Pro speaks words; SF Mono speaks numbers. A number set in the system face, or a word in the mono face, is a regression.

rules.name: The No-Chrome Rule
rules.body: If a mark is not a reading, a name, a rule, or a needle, it is not drawn.

dos: Do set every number in SF Mono at 11pt medium and every word in SF Pro at 11pt regular.
Do right-align all readings to the 12pt right inset so they share one edge.
Do reference colors by their semantic NSColor name so both appearances and Increased Contrast work without a hand-tuned hex.
Do render a missing register as N/A in the measurement face, and omit a row (such as Time left on AC) rather than showing it as n/a.
Do write the tier as a word in the status item's accessibility value, so state never rides on color alone.
Do keep the register 288pt wide with a fixed 104pt label column.
donts: Don't draw a background, border, card, shadow or tint behind a row. The menu's material is the surface.
Don't use the tier palette anywhere beyond the four named placements.
Don't set a word in the monospace face or a number in the system face.
Don't use a gradient, icon tile, progress ring or sparkline in place of the reading.
Don't invent a value. A missing key renders N/A; an unknown charging state renders Unknown.
Don't reorder the register: health, temperature with its scale, cycles, capacity, charge, power, lifetime.
Don't reflow the dropdown to fit a long reading — truncate it instead.
